headline: Review of change order task force requests and project updates for New SKHS and Curtis Corner.
summary: The committee will discuss approval of change order task force requests, updates on the New SKHS project and walk-thrus, and updates on the Curtis Corner project. The group will also discuss the date and time of the next meeting.
items: Recommendation for approval of change order task force requests
Update on walk-thrus for new SKHS
Discussion of next meeting date and time
